title: Rooftop Stories
logline: After a busy day, Mena finds a little breathing room on a city rooftop.
theme: A small change of perspective can make space in an ordinary day.
setting: An apartment rooftop above a busy contemporary city, with a concrete parapet, antennas and a distant water tank.
beginning: Mena steps out of the rooftop stairwell after a noisy day.
turn: She sits down and notices a pigeon has joined her.
climax: Mena watches the bird instead of rushing back downstairs.
ending: The same city fills the view, but Mena's shoulders are relaxed.

scenes.purpose: leave the rush of the day behind
scenes.continuity_anchor: concrete parapet, roof antennas and a cylindrical water tank to the right

scenes.purpose: find a moment of breathing room
